title: F5 Stage 1 Support Diagnosis, Bed Layer Audit & Visual Inspection Specification v2

governance.primary_objective: Establish end-to-end flow, 3D ParaView dynamic + full-animation visual review, and independent physical case batching (8/24/48 progression towards 336 total across F1..7)
governance.prerequisite_decoupling: Spatial grid convergence, dt/save error budgets, particle trajectory identity matching, and experimental Q-E are NOT Stage 1 shared prerequisites
governance.evidence_preservation: All historical negative results preserved; macro 058 all-pair failure retained; numerical precision explicitly marked NOT ACCEPTED
governance.anchor_case: Existing user-accepted F3 two-axis case is anchor; DP-resolution reruns and time-step repeats never recount towards independent case total

csv_format_tolerance.issue: PartVTK CSV exports contain preamble lines (TimeStep summary + blank lines) before the column header; gauge CSVs use semicolon delimiters. Prior worker failed with readline() and comma-only assumption.
csv_format_tolerance.resolution: Preamble skipping implemented, scanning lines until 'Pos.x [m]' token is found; automatic delimiter detection (',' or ';'); column indices extracted dynamically.

spatial_query_complexity.issue: Prior worker instantiated a 500 x N_bound broadcast array (up to 1.43 billion elements, >11.4 GB RAM per chunk), causing severe OOM and billion-distance quadratic costs.
spatial_query_complexity.resolution: scipy.spatial.cKDTree spatial indexing implemented (available in Root venv); O(N log M) query time, strictly bounded RAM (<= 100 MB), bounded fluid sample (<= 10,000 particles).

hollow_bed_vs_layer_support.issue: Prior worker inferred 'hollow 1-layer shell' purely from macro particle count comparisons against theoretical 3D solid volume.
hollow_bed_vs_layer_support.resolution: Geometric separation: sloped skin (m=0.28) distinguished from horizontal floor (z=0, z=0.05) and sidewalls (|y|>=0.145). Direct normal distance profile computed across bins [0, 1dp), [1dp, 2dp), [2dp, 3dp), [3dp, 4dp), [4dp+). Local deep interior cavity audited separately.

sidewall_marker_interpretation.issue: Sidewalls modeled with multi-face boxfill produce markers on multiple faces, leading to misleading count-based inferences.
sidewall_marker_interpretation.resolution: Explicit notice that marker counts across multiple faces do not indicate truncation or inadequate thickness from count alone.

causal_hypotheses_labeling.issue: Prior worker asserted the ~0.17 m macro subsidence was definitively caused by a hollow bed shell.
causal_hypotheses_labeling.resolution: Macro 057 ~0.17 m subsidence is an empirical observation; specific causal mechanisms are explicitly labeled NOT PROVEN.

frozen_gauge_operators.issue: Risk of gauge relocation or artificial masking to force passing results.
frozen_gauge_operators.resolution: All 6 frozen gauge operators (WG1, WG2, RunupToe, WG3, WG4, Crest) are preserved without relocation or masks. Macro 058 FAIL for both mechanisms retained as negative evidence.

visual_inspection_protocol.export_format: ParaView dynamic XDMF temporal sidecars (case.xmf) pointing to native trajectory HDF5 / PartVTK exports
acceptance_criteria: Zero unphysical boundary penetration or leakage through the continuous bed
No catastrophic explosive blowup or unphysical particle scattering
Stable quiescent water surface at t=0
Coherent wave generation, propagation, runup/overtopping, and reflection dynamics
Full 16.0s simulation completion with expected 801 frames

conditional_geometry_repair_policy.trigger_condition: ONLY if actual native solver simulation or visual inspection PROVES physical fluid penetration through the bed boundary.
conditional_geometry_repair_policy.repair_scope: Minimal non-intrusive XML geometry backing (e.g. adding 3-4 layer prism backing beneath bed STL surface); strictly NO automatic GPU spatial studies or unverified re-runs.

batch_progression_plan.parameter_space: Varied wavemaker paddle stroke S in [0.03, 0.06] m, wave period T in [1.2, 2.0] s, quiescent water depth H_swl in [0.38, 0.41] m, weir crest elevation in [0.42, 0.46] m
